spanish: Y dije a ellos: ¿A quién oro? Se arrancaron, y dieron a mí, y lo arrojé en el fuego, y salió este becerro.

findings.issue: Hithpael imperative 2mp is a command to the addressees; "Se arrancaron" is past indicative grouped with the following 3mp narrative, so the command becomes a completed act by a third party.
Object suffix is 3rd masculine plural; "lo" is singular.
"oro" matches the gold noun, but "¿A quién oro?" is also "to whom do I pray?", so the clause can be read as prayer.

notes: Say-to-them, give-to-me, in-the-fire, and this calf went out match the tokens.
